fixes.explanation: That's the point, friend. Paul asks, "If God is for us, who can be against us?" (Romans 8:31). He isn't saying no one will ever oppose us. He's saying that with God for us, no one can win against us. Picture someone standing next to the biggest, calmest person in the room, knowing who's beside them whatever comes at them.
